text:
jordan_sales: Hey ops — customer needs to extend our dedicated pool lease for tomorrow's hands-on demo. Can we add +6 GPUs for 3 hours and bump the autoscale down-cooldown to 90m? Demo pool: redwood-demo-east-2. Also need a short-lived API key for their engineer behind an IP allowlist.

maya_se: @jordan_sales we can do the GPUs + autoscale tweak but need finance ok for extra hours and security sign-off for the key/KMS. Who will pay if we go over demo credits?

ryan_finance: If this stays inside demo credits we're good. If not, it's treated as a one-off overage and billed. Ballpark: 6 gpus * 3 hrs * $X/hr =~ $Y. Send a formal request by EOD and we can approve.

ben_ops: Quick ops checklist: pool name, UTC start/end, allowed IPs, ephemeral key TTL. I can apply the autoscale change. Example policy we're going to push: 
```json
{"min_replicas":2,"max_replicas":12,"scale_up_cooldown_sec":120,"scale_down_cooldown_sec":5400}
```
scale_down_cooldown_sec 5400 ~= 90m. This prevents aggressive scale-down during the demo.

maya_se: We'll also attach a temporary reservation so traffic stays on dedicated nodes and doesn't route to cheaper tiers. I can stage a canary before the demo.

jordan_sales: Can we have the API key named `demo-temp-clientA-2026` with TTL 4h? Their engineer (sam_customer) needs it for prep. Also need vault path or access method.

ciso_jen: Need customer's SOC2 snapshot and the IP list. No plain-text keys via email — keys must be in the vault and delivered via secure link. KMS/HSM policy applies; ephemeral keys are fine.

ops-bot: scheduled change queued by ben_ops for 2026-03-22T15:00Z. change-id: ch_1788_01

ben_ops: Pushed autoscale policy to staging and created a temporary reservation slot. API key created in vault but ACLs pending until security confirms IP allowlist. Will promote to prod once we get approval. :white_check_mark:

sam_customer: Sending IP range now: 203.0.113.0/24. Also: will this demo hit our committed RPS/rate limits or will you elevate?

maya_se: We'll temp-elevate rate limits to 2x committed for the booked window and revert afterward. Rate-limit elevation is scoped to pool redwood-demo-east-2 and demo keys.

ryan_finance: Sending invoice estimate to acct@client.com now. Please include the approved change-id in billing notes.

jordan_sales: Thanks — please ping when API key is accessible and reservation is active. :party:

ciso_jen: IPs received and vetted. Approving vault access. Reminder: HSM-backed key policy enforced; keys rotate at TTL expiry.

ben_ops: API key provisioned at vault path `secret/demo/1788543210`. I'll DM the client the secure access link once vault ACLs are applied. Deployed autoscale change to prod at scheduled time.

ops-bot: change ch_1788_01 completed at 2026-03-22T15:02Z

jordan_sales: Verified with client — demo went smoothly. Reservation released after the window and keys rotated. Closing thread. :tada:
